newsitem.title: FRANCE: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde Sept 10.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde Sept 10.

text.p: These are leading stories in afternoon daily Le Monde.
-- Conservative senator Philippe Marini calls for a reform of corporate law including a new definition for misuse of corporate funds.
-- Prime Minister Alain Juppe favours more flexible approach to private pension funds to allow people to choose to take their money in annuities or in a lump sum.
-- Defense Minister Charles Millon to present new status of arms procurement agency tomorrow. Agency should operate like a civilian company, seek cost cutting.
-- Biotechnology firm LFB and U.S. Baxter sign agreement to produce therapeutic hemoglobin jointly in France.
